_about: The reload of the Type-87 as the pilot sees it (first-person gun file atpov_titan_triple_threat).
Ronin's own reload (the Leadwall's) feeds a drum in at the gun's left side; the Type-87's box magazine stands on top
of the gun, out of the left hand's reach.  So, while the stock timing and sounds stay frame for frame:
the gun cants over towards the pilot and comes a little towards the middle; the left hand takes the old magazine by
its top, pulls it up out of the well and carries it away out of view, where the game hides it (frame 22) and shows
the new one (frame 31) in the same hand; the hand carries it over the well and pushes it in (seated by frame 42,
before the large rumble at 43), lets go and returns to the stock motion, and the gun returns onto its stock
motion.  The right hand keeps its stock hold of the grip.
Frames are those of the full reload (76 frames at 30 per second); the two 'late' animations the game resumes
from are frames 26-75 and 58-75 of it, and the empty-magazine versions are the same motion.
Ronin's reload hides its magazine piece at frame 10, before a hand could take it (owner, 2026-11-16: 'the hand
does not grab the mag and take it').  That event only switches the magazine piece of the first-person gun off
and on; it is moved to when the hand has carried the old magazine out of view.  The late reloads, the
milestones, the ammo refill and the sounds are not touched.
The Type-87's magazine (its two box pieces) rides def_detail_3, a child of the gun that no animation but the
reloads moves, so it stays on the gun everywhere else.  (The Leadwall's own magazine bone turns its drum by up
to 80 degrees on every shot.)  Its stored range is widened for the reloads, the only animations that move it.
The magazine's motion relative to its seat on the gun, about its own centre, in the gun's frame
(x the gun's left, y up, z forward; game units and degrees, turn applied about z, then y, then x).
Between two keys the motion eases in and out.  The left hand holds it from frame 'hold_from' to 'hold_until'
(left_hand below), so these keys are also the hand's path.  Frames 22-30 the game hides it: the old magazine
is swapped for the new one out of view.
Added to the stock gun motion: a roll about the gun's own barrel (negative = the top towards the pilot's left)
and a shift in the pilot's view (left, forward, up), in game units.
The left hand is stock until 'stock_until', eases onto the seated magazine by 'hold_from', holds it by its top
(palm on the top cap, fingers pointing forward along it) until 'hold_until', lifts off by 'lift' (gun frame)
and eases back onto the stock motion by 'stock_again_from'.  'closed_hand_frame' is a stock reload frame in
which the stock left hand is closed, used to tell which side of the hand is the palm.
left_hand._release: after letting go the hand drops out of view to where the stock hand is at frame 'stock_again_from' (reached by 'released_by'), waits there, and follows the stock motion from that frame
left_hand._elbow: the elbow is kept as near as the arm allows to where the stock animation has it, moved by 'elbow_shift' (left, forward, up)

_about: How the hand holds the magazine (owner, 2026-11-16: 'make sure he's actually holding it ... holding the mag
basically and putting in a new one'): like a book taken off a shelf by its top.  The palm lies flat on the
magazine's left side ('palm_faces', gun frame), the knuckles run along the straight part of its top edge
('knuckles_along_edge' = where along it, 0 rear .. 1 front; 'knuckles_above_edge' units above it), and every
finger is bent at its own joints, about 'curl_axis' (the joint's own axes), one degree at a time until it
would come within 'clearance' of the magazine, at most 'most_bend_degrees'.  The thumb is closed the way
the stock animation closes it, from 'thumb_open_degrees' open until it touches.  Only joints turn: the hand
is not moved or resized.  The fingers close into this grip over 'close_frames' as the hand arrives and open
over 'open_frames' as it lets go; between, they hold it, the old magazine out and the new one in.

thumb_swing._about: the thumb swung out in the palm's plane first (about the palm's normal, wrist frame), towards the magazine's rear edge

grip._approach: the hand comes in onto the magazine from this far off (gun frame: left, up, forward), fingers open, and closes them as it arrives; when it lets go it opens them first and then moves off ('lift', then away)
